description: Read one record by type and slug: a platform sheet (specs with test conditions, provenance and sources, autonomy by task, evidence stage, access, lifecycle), a documented case study (sourced facts, published KPIs, lessons), a guide, a cited source by id — or, with type 'source' and no slug, the whole resolved bibliography with each source's evidence level — or the taxonomy and methodology (no slug). A spec or KPI the maker has not published is null with status 'unpublished' — report it as unknown, never estimate it. Use this after search_physical_ai, with the type and slug it returned.

locale.description: Language of the returned body. Default: en.

slug.description: Required for platform, case_study and guide, e.g. 'spot'. For source, a source id; omit it to list every source. Ignored for taxonomy and methodology.

type.description: platform, case_study, guide, source, taxonomy or methodology.

name: get_physical_ai_item
title: Get one Physical AI platform, deployment, guide or reference
